newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: PSG to raise 62.85 mln rand in share issue.
newsitem.headline: PSG to raise 62.85 mln rand in share issue.

text.p: South Africa's financial services firm PSG Group Ltd said on Tuesday it would raise 62.85 million rand through the issue of shares for cash to Nedbank Nominees Ltd, on behalf of a number of institutional investors.
The group said the cash, together with existing resources, would be used to implement PSG's strategic objectives and strengthen its position in the financial services industry.

PSG said that had the cash issue been in existence for the year to end-February 1997, and had it earned an after-tax return of 10 percent, proforma earnings per share would have risen to 39.1 cents from proforma earnings of 32.6 cents before the issue.
